title: Stop exhausting yourself before prayer
summary: This meets the worn-out mind still testing one more solution. The line turns fatigue into an honest cry to the Father.
takeaway: Pray before another round of self-rescue.
lifeApplication: When you catch yourself researching, fixing, and rehearsing past capacity, put the phone down and let the shoulders drop. Ask for help before another failing tactic.

source.shortMeaning: Exhaustion becomes prayer when self-rescue finally runs out.
source.lifeApplication: When you are spent, ask for help before starting another rescue attempt.

evidence.coreClaim: Exhaustion becomes prayer when self-rescue finally runs out.
evidence.turn: Call for shelter before fear becomes your only voice.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you catch yourself researching, fixing, and rehearsing past capacity, put the phone down and let the shoulders drop. Ask for help before another failing tactic.
